Corpse Knight/two-knights-each-drain-for: Each permanent with the trigger triggers separately (CR 603.3d, CR 603.6): with two Corpse Knights in play, Grizzly Bears entering must push BOTH abilities and drain 2. The engine poses the trigger_order ask with both instances and the harness answers both, but only ONE trigger_push event lands (verified on the event stream: a single trigger_push for obj 2; obj 3's trigger is dropped), so the opponent loses 1 life, not 2. Observed: p1 at 17; expected p1 at 18.
C.A.M.P./non-shared-color-tap-makes-coun: The ETB/tap trigger's 'If that creature shares a color with the mana that land produced, create a Junk token' is a Condition gate the engine does not evaluate: the shared-color check is skipped and the Junk token is always created. Observed with a fortified Plains tapped for {W} and the blue Welcoming Vampire chosen: the counter is applied (Vampire 3/4, correct) but a Junk token is created too; expected none (CR 603.2c conditions). The shared-color sibling scenario passes because W/G also share there -- this row is the only half that diverges.
Expert-Level Safe/enters-exiling-top-two: 'When Expert-Level Safe enters, exile the top two cards of your library face down' never happens: the library stays at its seeded 37 cards (CR 603.2, 708.5). No ask and no zone move -- the ETB trigger either never matches or its exile is a silent no-op.
Expert-Level Safe/matched-secret-choices: The {1},{T} secret-choice ability stops after the controller's choice: p0 is asked (and answers 2), but the opponent is never asked, no reveal happens, the Safe is never sacrificed, and the two cards exiled with it are never returned to hand. Observed: library 37, hand 0, Safe on the battlefield; expected (CR 602.2, 701.6): both players choose, the match is revealed, the Safe goes to the graveyard and Forest+Island return to hand (library 35).
Expert-Level Safe/mismatched-secret-choi: Same stop after the controller's choice as the sibling row, for the mismatch path: the opponent is never asked, and the mismatch's 'exile the top card of your library face down' never happens. Observed: library stays 37 and the Safe stays on the battlefield; expected (CR 602.2, 701.15): library 34.
Exemplar of Light/second-gain-same-turn-: CR 603.2 / the card's 'This ability triggers only once each turn'. Expected: two life gains in one turn put two +1/+1 counters on it but draw one card (hand 1 after casting both Angel's Mercy). Observed: both counters land and the draw ability triggers a second time (hand 2). The engine honours a trigger's per-turn limit only for a whitelist of trigger modes (rules/trigger_match.go actionTriggerModes); the counter-added-once mode is not on it, so the limit is silently ignored. New root, found by the FDN audit batch 5; no ticket yet.
Exemplar of Light/life-gain-then-another: CR 603.2 / the card's 'This ability triggers only once each turn'. Expected: after the life-gain counter has drawn, a Battlegrowth counter the same turn draws nothing (hand 1). Observed: a second card is drawn (hand 2). Same root as second-gain-same-turn-counter-but-no-second-draw.
Exemplar of Light/counter-put-by-an-oppo: CR 109.5: the draw ability reads 'whenever YOU put one or more +1/+1 counters on this creature'. Expected: a +1/+1 counter put on it by an opponent's Battlegrowth draws nothing (p0 hand 0). Observed: p0 draws a card. The counter-added trigger matcher does not read who caused the placement (the 'you put' source filter), although the engine tracks the adder for the sibling player-added mode (rules/trigmatch_counters.go). Confidence the engine is wrong: fairly high (the reading rests on 109.5, not on a printed ruling). New root, found by the FDN audit batch 5; no ticket yet.
Consuming Aberration/casting-a-spell-mil: The trigger has each opponent reveal cards until a land, 'then puts those cards into their graveyard' -- the land included. Expected with Shock, Grizzly Bears, Forest on top: all three in the graveyard (4 with the Mountain already there) and the Aberration 4/4. Observed: the two nonland cards go to the graveyard but the Forest goes to the opponent's HAND (graveyard 3, Aberration 3/3). The card's script names only the destination of the revealed cards and the engine sends the found card to its default destination, hand (effects/cardflow.go). New root, found by the FDN audit batch 5; no ticket yet -- every reveal-until effect scripted the same way gives the opponent a free card.
Consuming Aberration/land-on-top-mills-j: Expected the Forest on top to be put into the graveyard (2 cards, Aberration 2/2). Observed: it goes to the opponent's hand (graveyard 1, 1/1). Same root as casting-a-spell-mills-the-opponent-until-a-land: the revealed land goes to the opponent's hand instead of their graveyard.

Consuming Aberration/two-spells-two-trig: Expected two triggers to mill Forest and Swamp (graveyard 3, Aberration 3/3). Observed: both lands go to the opponent's hand (graveyard 1, 1/1).
